Donta Hall was born on August 7, 1997.
Donta Hall is an American-born naturalized Azerbaijani professional basketball player.
Saski Baskonia is Donta Hall's current team.
The ACB league and EuroLeague are the leagues in which Donta Hall plays professionally.
Donta Hall played college basketball for the Alabama Crimson Tide.
Donta Hall grew up in Luverne, Alabama.
Luverne High School is where Donta Hall attended high school.
Donta Hall's father Donald suffered a fatal heart attack at one of his junior varsity games.
Donta Hall was named first team Class 2A All-State after averaging 11.7 points, 10.1 rebounds and 6.7 blocks per game during his junior season.
During Donta Hall's junior season, he led Luverne to a 24–2 record and the State final.
Donta Hall was rated the 81st best player in his class by ESPN.
Donta Hall committed to play college basketball at Alabama at the end of his junior year over offers from UAB, Mississippi State and Troy.
As a senior, Donta Hall averaged a triple-double with 22.6 points, 18.1 rebounds and almost 12 blocks per game.
Donta Hall was named the Class 2A Player of the Year as a senior.
Donta Hall was named first team All-State as a senior.
As a true freshman at Alabama, Donta Hall averaged 2.8 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.7 blocks per game (6th in the Southeastern Conference).
In December of his sophomore season, Donta Hall entered the starting lineup for the Crimson Tide.
During his sophomore season, Donta Hall averaged six points, 5.5 rebounds and 1.4 blocks over 34 games with 20 starts.
As a junior at Alabama, Donta Hall set an Alabama single-season record, led the SEC, and finished second in the nation with a 72.6 field goal percentage.
During his junior season, Donta Hall averaged 10.6 points per game and led the team with 2.0 blocks (5th in the SEC) and 6.6 rebounds per game.
Donta Hall was named to the SEC All-Defensive team as a junior.
As a senior at Alabama, Donta Hall led the SEC with 8.8 rebounds per game.
During his senior season, Donta Hall also averaged 10.5 points and 1.6 blocks per game.
Donta Hall finished his collegiate career with 1,014 points, 850 rebounds, and 228 blocked shots (seventh-most in Alabama history) in 135 games played with 85 starts.
Donta Hall played in the 2019 NBA Summer League as a member of the Detroit Pistons roster.
During his time in the 2019 NBA Summer League, Donta Hall averaged 16.8 minutes, 6.0 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.6 assists, 1.0 steal and 2.2 blocks per game.
Donta Hall signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the Detroit Pistons on July 23, 2019.
On October 20, 2019, Donta Hall was waived by the Detroit Pistons.
Subsequently, Donta Hall joined the team's NBA G League affiliate, the Grand Rapids Drive, as an affiliate player.
Donta Hall missed a game with an undisclosed injury on December 31, 2019.
On January 4, 2020, Donta Hall scored a team-high 24 points and had 12 rebounds, two steals, two blocks and one assist in a 117–113 loss to Raptors 905.
Donta Hall was named Midseason All-NBA G League for the Eastern Conference.
During his time with the Grand Rapids Drive, Donta Hall averaged 15.4 points and 10.5 rebounds per game while shooting 66 percent from the field in 36 games.
Donta Hall was named Second Team All-NBA G League and to the NBA G League All-Defensive Team and the NBA G League All-Rookie Team.
On February 22, 2020, Donta Hall signed with the Detroit Pistons on a 10-day contract.
After Markieff Morris reached a buyout agreement with the Pistons, Donta Hall was promoted to the main roster.
Donta Hall made his debut for the Detroit Pistons on February 25, recording four points, four rebounds, and an assist against the Denver Nuggets.
On March 3, 2020, Donta Hall signed a second 10-day contract with the Detroit Pistons.
During his time with the Pistons, Donta Hall played in four games and averaged 1.5 points and 3.8 rebounds in 12.0 minutes per game.
On July 10, 2020, Donta Hall signed with the Brooklyn Nets as a substitute player for the remainder of the season.
During his time with the Brooklyn Nets, Donta Hall averaged 6.6 points, 4.6 rebounds and 1.0 blocks in 17.0 minutes played over five seeding games in the 2020 NBA Bubble.
On January 14, 2021, Donta Hall was added to the roster of the NBA G League Ignite.
On February 26, 2021, Donta Hall signed a 10-day contract with the Toronto Raptors and was instantly assigned to their affiliate, Raptors 905.
On March 3, 2021, Donta Hall was recalled to the Toronto Raptors.
By the end of his contract, Donta Hall had only played for the Raptors 905.
In 12 games with both Ignite and Raptors 905, Donta Hall averaged 10.2 points, 8.3 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 2.08 blocks in 24.8 minutes while shooting .625 (50–80) from the floor.
On April 13, 2021, Donta Hall signed a 10-day contract with the Orlando Magic.
On April 23, 2021, Donta Hall signed a second 10-day contract and was waived on May 2.
On May 9, 2021, Donta Hall signed for the rest of the season after the Magic was granted the hardship exception.
During his time with the Orlando Magic, Donta Hall averaged 5.6 points and 4.8 rebounds per game in 13 games.
On August 5, 2021, Donta Hall signed with AS Monaco, his first European club.
Donta Hall chose to re-sign with Monaco in 2023 over reported NBA offers.
